redfin.remarks: Welcome to a home overflowing with possibility on a prime sun-drenched corner lot in the heart of Westchester. Bathed in natural light and nestled along a charming tree-lined street, this inviting residence captures the essence of quintessential California living. Ideally situated just moments from the renowned Westchester Playhouse, residents will enjoy a vibrant neighborhood atmosphere with convenient access to local schools, major freeways, and everything the surrounding Westside has to offer. Inside, rich character and warmth shine through with an artistic blend of Purple Heart, Oak, and Teak hardwood flooring flowing throughout the home. A spacious family room addition dramatically expands the living footprint and offers incredible flexibility—easily accommodating a future third bedroom, home office, nursery, fitness space, or remaining as an expansive gathering room designed for effortless everyday living. The thoughtfully designed kitchen is a true culinary centerpiece, featuring a six-burner range, stainless steel appliances , striking Ossido Negro porcelain tile , stone countertops, and conveniently located laundry. A side entrance creates seamless indoor-outdoor flow, making backyard entertaining and grilling a breeze. The spa-inspired bathroom delivers unforgettable design with its one-of-a-kind floating Koi pond sink , walk-in shower, natural stone flooring, and dramatic black and green slate accents. A stylish transition space between the living and family rooms currently serves as an inviting bar area but could easily transform into an elegant formal dining room. Step outside to your private backyard retreat where blooming hibiscus trees frame a relaxing jacuzzi and a detached two-car garage presents exciting ADU potential for future expansion, guest quarters, or additional income opportunities. This is a rare opportunity to create your dream lifestyle in one of Westchester’s most connected locations—just minutes from the South Bay, the Westside, SpaceX, and the energy of Silicon Beach. Don’t miss your chance to make this exceptional property your own.
